notes.title: Campaign Mode, New Soundtracks
notes.content:
- Syko Swinger now has a campaign mode where you can play 15 levels.
   Each level will explore an aspect of the game and will put you just on your toes.
 - Added 3 sick soundtracks that blend well with the visuals of the game.
 - Unlimited lives mode is now Rage Mode and is limited to 3 minutes.
 - Also added a Seizure Warning before game starts.

notes.title: New Unlimited Lives Mode
notes.content:
[h1]Unlimited Lives Mode[/h1]
I've added a new [b]Unlimited Lives[/b] mode where you can bang those spiky red devils as much as you want. 
In this mode, I've been able to score very high with minimal dexterity in movement.

[previewyoutube=cMwa1UVNbJ8;full][/previewyoutube]

[i]Why?[/i]
Thanks to a reviewer, I found out that the game can be hard for some and people may never reach to the real juice of the game which starts after scoring 1000 points.

This motivated me to create the Unlimited Lives mode. You can pretty much just move the mouse randomly and start scoring. Although you will need to make proper circles to keep the momentum going which is a hard requirement for scoring.

 - Enjoy!
